value.answer: Messi, for me. Seven Ballon d'Ors, a World Cup with Argentina in 2022, and he kept producing at the top level for almost two decades. Pelé and Maradona are the other names people fight over, but Messi has the strongest all-round case. I can't check live stats or current form right now, so if you want to argue about who's playing best this season, that part's on you.
